verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents scraping and crawling into Markdown or HTML, plus schema-shaped JSON extraction. Nothing in the evidence shows an option to return semantically chunked output for retrieval pipelines. Output chunking is a fair axis for a web-data API, so the lack of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can request semantically chunked output instead of one large content blob, so it feeds cleanly into a retrieval pipeline
